name.en: Canadian Solar CS6.2-54TM class, 1961 x 1134 x 30 mm, 108 TOPCon cells as printed
name.es: Clase Canadian Solar CS6.2-54TM, 1961 x 1134 x 30 mm, 108 celdas TOPCon segun ficha

description.en: Canadian Solar TOPHiKu6 CS6.2-54TM (495-520 W range) datasheet: 1961 x 1134 x 30 mm, 23.3 kg, 108 cells printed as 2 x (9 x 6), 3.2 mm front glass, anodized aluminium frame, IP68 junction box with 3 bypass diodes, 4 mm2 cable, MC4-EVO2 connector option. Model name '54TM' is printed as is; the cell count printed is 108.
description.es: Ficha Canadian Solar TOPHiKu6 CS6.2-54TM (rango 495-520 W): 1961 x 1134 x 30 mm, 23,3 kg, 108 celdas impresas como 2 x (9 x 6), vidrio frontal de 3,2 mm, marco de aluminio anodizado, caja IP68 con 3 diodos de bypass, cable de 4 mm2, conector MC4-EVO2 como opcion. El nombre de modelo '54TM' se mantiene tal como se imprime; el numero de celdas impreso es 108.
